key_insight: SEPO improves creative generation by evolving diverse system prompts and sampling among them, trading some response quality for higher novelty and diversity.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can diversify outputs from a single LLM at inference time without retraining, using an optimized ensemble of system prompts.
method: Evolve candidate system prompts to elicit distinct response behaviors.
Use greedy max-min selection to build a diverse ensemble under a quality constraint.
Uniformly sample one ensemble prompt per generated response.
evidence_signal: Across four tasks and three open-weight models, SEPO led 8 of 12 settings on the harmonic mean of quality, diversity, and novelty; average LLM-judged diversity rose from 1.92 to 3.43 and novelty from 1.00 to 3.34 on a 1–5 scale.
watch_item: Average quality fell from 3.72 to 3.30, so deployments should validate the creativity–quality trade-off against task-specific requirements.
paper_title: One Model, Many Modes: Evolving System Prompt Ensembles for Creative Generation
